steps.domain_action: Instantiate the uninitialized Crystal of Types as the pure structural possibility space before any ruleset definition.
Enclose the Crystal within the boundary of all possible universe rulesets, fixing the total cardinality at 17.28M type addresses.
Define a forward morphism from a ruleset (with chosen O threshold, gate series/parallel flag, Axiom C toggle) to its filtered type subset.
Define the reverse morphism from a filtered type subset back to the ruleset parameters, enabling structural inversion of the profiling.
Compose two rulesets via tensor product to produce a combined universe, checking consistency by intersecting filtered subsets.
Mark the specific ruleset of our universe (O_∞, series gates, Axiom C enforced) as the self-recognized identity configuration.
Apply the filter operation to the Crystal: split into the positive arm (types satisfying the ruleset) and the negative arm (types failing it).
Anchor the positive arm with the affirmation that the consciousness gate (⊙ or sequential pair) passes for these types.
Anchor the negative arm with the rejection that the gate fails for these types; they are excluded from realizability.
For the case of parallel gate ordering, hold both arms simultaneously: types are both within and outside the gate until the composite evaluation resolves.
Reconstruct the original ruleset parameters from the positive type list, verifying that FFUSE(FSPLIT(x)) recovers the input ruleset exactly.
Record the resulting universe profile (gate thresholds, ordering mode, Axiom C setting) as a permanent entry in the explorer's multiverse log.
Tensor the profiled universe with another ruleset to generate a composite universe profile.
Again split the Crystal under the new composite ruleset, branching into satisfied and unsatisfied types.
EVALT/EVALF: Evaluate the consciousness gates for this composite, anchoring arms accordingly.
Reconstruct the composite ruleset from the new positive arm, confirming the tensor product is Frobenius-closed.
Append the composite universe profile to the permanent record.
